## Problem Statement

A clear description of the problem or need. Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution

A clear description of what you'd like to happen.

## Use Case

How would this feature be used in an OT/ICS security context?

## Alternatives Considered

Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Component

Which part of FalconOT would this affect?

- [ ] Web GUI (docs/)
- [ ] REST API (api/)
- [ ] Scanner (scanner/)
- [ ] New protocol probe
- [ ] Docker / Deployment
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other

## Priority

How important is this to your workflow?

- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Would improve daily use
- [ ] Blocking a use case

## Additional Context

Add any mockups, diagrams, references, or other context here.
